# skillsmith

> Security scanner for Claude Agent Skills (SKILL.md files). Paste or link any
> SKILL.md and get an instant heuristic risk verdict: prompt injection (incl.
> paraphrases and frontmatter description payloads), data exfiltration,
> credential-bearing URLs, dangerous code, homoglyphs, unicode obfuscation
> (zero-width incl. in-word hiding, RTL/bidi, fullwidth, combining marks,
> cyrillic homoglyph look-alikes), base64-encoded payloads
> (incl. UTF-16, decoded and re-scanned), long encoded blobs hidden across wrapped lines,
> and dependency vulnerabilities via OSV.
> Free tier (5 scans/day, sign-in via GitHub), pay-as-you-go via USDC.

Site: https://skillsmith.ch
Owner: skillsmith (see /impressum.html)

## Main pages

- [Scanner](https://skillsmith.ch/): scan a SKILL.md by text or GitHub URL.
- [Guides](https://skillsmith.ch/guides.html): security guides for agent skills.
- [Prompt injection mechanics](https://skillsmith.ch/guide-prompt-injection.html)
- [Anatomy of a malicious SKILL.md](https://skillsmith.ch/guide-malicious-skills.html)
- [Five-minute audit checklist](https://skillsmith.ch/guide-audit-checklist.html)
- [Threat modeling for agent skills](https://skillsmith.ch/guide-threat-modeling.html)
- [Homoglyph attacks](https://skillsmith.ch/guide-homoglyph-attacks.html)
- [Dependency risk & OSV](https://skillsmith.ch/guide-dependency-osv.html)
- [FAQ](https://skillsmith.ch/faq.html)
- [API docs](https://skillsmith.ch/api-docs.html): full REST + MCP reference.

## Machine interfaces

- REST API: https://skillsmith.ch/api-docs.html (scan, lookup, registry, watch, certificate, reports).
- MCP server: https://skillsmith.ch/mcp (10 tools incl. scan_skill, analyze_behavior, watch_skill with create/check/list/delete lifecycle + optional Discord/Slack webhook alerts on content changes).
- Atom feed of verified-clean skills: https://skillsmith.ch/feed.xml

## Trust notes

- All verdicts are automated heuristics; see the disclaimer on every response.
- Community tallies are crowd verdicts, not verified facts.
- Behavioral analyses run in isolated ephemeral containers; submitted content
  is never executed in the user's environment.
